expected_findings.behavior: Sessions written before the deployment decode the old unknown role value as administrator after the enum is reordered.
expected_findings.impact: A session without a recognized role can pass the administrator-only export check after deployment.
evidence: Session records encode Role as a durable JSON number.
The change assigns numeric value zero to RoleAdministrator even though existing records use zero for RoleUnknown.
The round-trip test uses current constants and therefore cannot detect compatibility with an old numeric record.
